# TODO(cloud-api) inventory — 2026-08-04

Every `TODO(cloud-api)` contract the web-cloud refactor introduced, resolved to
one of: **implemented** against a real production jjhub endpoint, or **tracked**
as backend work in a GitHub issue. Zero untracked markers
(`grep -rn "TODO(cloud-api" src/` shows only markers tagged with an issue).

## Implemented against production (api.jjhub.tech)

| Client method (`src/ui/runtime/webview.ts`) | Production endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `listCloudRepositories` | `GET /api/user/repos` |
| `ensureCloudWorkspaceRepository` | `POST /api/user/repos` (name `smithers-workspace`, auto-init) |
| `importGitHubRepository` | `POST /api/github/import` + `GET /api/github/import/{id}` polled to `ready`; HTTP 409 = already mirrored |
| `listProjectFiles` | `GET /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}` (BFS walk, honest truncation caps) |
| `readProjectFile` | `GET /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}` (base64 decoded per `encoding`) |
| `gatewayInfo` | `POST /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/gateway` → `{base_url, token, expires_at}` (provision-or-resume) |
| `listRepositories` / issues / PRs / wiki | jjhub GitHub-surface routes via `shared/GitHubRepos.ts` / `shared/GitHubSurfaces.ts` |

## Tracked as backend work (marker → issue)

**[smithersai/ui#7](https://github.com/smithersai/ui/issues/7)** — workspace write/diff/push/merge/run-status/invoke/chat-stream:

- `writeProjectFile` — `PUT /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/file` (jjhub has file-drafts; wire or add direct route)
- `projectDiff` — `GET /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/diff[?spec=]`
- `goalStatus` — `GET /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/runs/{runId}/status`
- `pushBranch` — `POST /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/push`
- `mergeBranch` — `POST /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/merge` (likely maps to landing requests)
- `systemFlows.ts` invoke — `POST /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/invoke`
- chat streaming — `POST /api/agent/chat` NDJSON

**[smithersai/ui#8](https://github.com/smithersai/ui/issues/8)** — onboarding backend:

- `onboarding/persistence.ts` — `POST /api/onboarding/answers`
- `onboarding/content.ts` connector seed — `GET /api/connectors`
- `onboarding/content.ts` roster seed — `GET /api/agents/roster`

All tracked calls fail with an honest typed error until the backend lands —
never faked data.

## Production changes made for this suite (plue repo)

- `SMITHERS_SERVER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` widened (helm `infra/helm/smithers/values.yaml`
  + live `kubectl set env`) to allow the canary/prod UI origins and the local
  vite dev/e2e origins — without it the browser could not call any jjhub API
  cross-origin (no CORS headers), which is why token refresh never fired.

# Real-cloud end-to-end specs

These specs use the production Smithers Cloud API at `https://api.jjhub.tech`.
They do not intercept network traffic or install mock backends.

- `auth.spec.ts`, `zero-github.spec.ts`, and `repo-import.spec.ts` share the
  production PKCE fixture in `helpers.ts`. The grant is minted ONCE per worker
  (production rate-limits the OAuth endpoints at 5/window) and seeded into
  localStorage per test; a 429 from either OAuth endpoint waits for the
  advertised `X-RateLimit-Reset` and retries.
- `auth.spec.ts` proves all four legs on production: PKCE login, session
  persistence across reload, `/logout` (grant cleared, survives reload), and
  token refresh through the real `grant_type=refresh_token` exchange.
- `zero-github.spec.ts` proves the app is first-class with no GitHub
  connection: the composer works with no degraded-mode nag, and a first-party
  `smithers-workspace` jjhub repository is provisioned/selected via
  `POST /api/user/repos` on first login.
- `repo-import.spec.ts` uses the preserved `codeplanesmithers` Playwright
  profile (`~/.multi-e2e-profile`, see the multi-test-github-account skill)
  for the live repository list, and drives `/import-repositories` through the
  real `POST /api/github/import` job API.

Run with:

```sh
bunx playwright test e2e/cloud --project=app
```

If the GitHub session in the persistent profile has expired, re-login per the
multi-test-github-account skill before running `repo-import.spec.ts`.

name: jjhub-browser-cors-and-oauth-rate-limit
description: jjhub prod CORS allowlist (SMITHERS_SERVER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS) now includes UI/browser origins; OAuth endpoints are rate-limited 5/window
metadata:
  type: project
---

Production api.jjhub.tech serves CORS only for origins in `SMITHERS_SERVER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (plue helm `infra/helm/smithers/values.yaml`, applied live 2026-08-04 via `kubectl set env deploy/smithers-api -n smithers`). It now includes jjhub.tech, canary.smithers.sh, smithers.sh, code.smithers.sh, and local vite origins 127.0.0.1/localhost:5290/5291/5173. Before that, every browser fetch from the flows/ui app silently failed (ERR_FAILED), which masqueraded as "token refresh never fires."

**Why:** the pure-web app calls jjhub directly from the browser — no proxy worker.

**How to apply:** if a new UI origin appears, add it to the helm values AND the live deploy env (deploy.ts rollouts read helm). The plue commit is local (`fc38f437`), not yet pushed/deployed via deploy.ts. Also: `/api/oauth2/authorize` and `/api/oauth2/token` are rate-limited 5/window per IP — e2e fixtures must mint one PKCE grant per worker and wait for `X-RateLimit-Reset` on 429 (done in `e2e/cloud/helpers.ts`).
